claim_title: feature amplification raises alpha-helix content (dose-response; verify PASS)

figures.caption: Dose-response: amplifying the alpha-helix feature set monotonically raises encoded-protein alpha-helix fraction from 0.48 (baseline) to 0.83 (alpha=32), Spearman rho=0.76, p=1.7e-5; clean-quality optimum at alpha=8.
Capability control: valid-ORF rate holds at or above baseline (0.872) through alpha=8 and dips only at alpha>=16, confirming alpha=8 as the clean-quality optimum.
